description: Make a public publication private: it gets a new private link and the public link stops working; a custom domain on it is detached. One-way. Returns the new link, namespace and id, plus a new management link when the publication had one; the owner token stays the same.

namespace.description: Publication namespace; only `public` publications can be made private

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

name: make_private
title: Make private
